sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Fire Release, Lightning Release

system.description:
You can only cast this jutsu if you have at least 1 or more Starlight’s active. When this jutsu is cast, you send each active Starlight, into an unstable state, beyond fission. All active Starlight’s detonate, filling a 20-foot radius, centered on each point. All creature in range of a detonation must make both a Dexterity and Constitution saving throws. After this jutsu’s casting, all active Starlight’s are dispelled. A creature in the area of 2 or more Starlight detonations, makes both the Dexterity and Constitution saving throws, at disadvantage.

On a failed Dexterity saving throw, they take 5d10 fire damage and are marked as a Convergence until the end of your next turn.

On a failed Constitution saving throw, they are Blinded, gain 3 ranks of Dazzled, and are Dazed for the next minute, remaking their Constitution saving throw, ending the Blinded and Dazed condition on a success.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above A-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, and increase the damage by 1d10.
